# Pull request

## Change

Describe what changed and why.

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated affected setup, API, architecture or runbook pages.
- [ ] Added a decision-log entry if the design changed.
- [ ] Updated the changelog if needed.
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/check_docs.py`.
- [ ] Asked the other team member to review the docs and try any changed commands.

If no documentation change is needed, explain why:

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Link the successful CI run when available.
